regions.full_page: Cronic Penticitis Cured. Mrs. Georgia Bowers 49 not a Catholic 1028 Chene Ave - ten days down "in Most extreme Agony" is enrolled in S.M. A. regions.full_page: 49 Inch Dwarf At 17 Wishes To Start Growing. Non-Catholic. Russell Jay just 17 years to-morrow and 49 inches tall is enrolled in the S. M.A. To-day -- Asks Fr. S. to "make me grow." He will sign his name: - (Russell Jay) 1927, Jan. 2nd Reported grew 42 inches. - 1st change in 12 years - now developing normally .
